whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Dental Square,

I noticed your clinic has an outstanding 4.9★ rating with 52 reviews in Gardanibagh, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct patient appointment bookings.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, treatment menu, aur clinic timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dentalsquare

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Dental Square team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke dental clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with gardanibagh location details, direct WhatsApp booking, and a patient-friendly service showcase. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact treatments, actual clinic photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
